readings: The seat's step-15 answers, Q7, verbatim: "Code's defaults are the seat's, declared at G-PWR on Q1's terms (strikable until v1.0's commit; a strike recomputes figures only)".

Q7 (a), verbatim: "n_j at each look from the projection — each arm launches to its L, interleaved by the campaign rule, every sham session running its 10 rounds — with two cases beside: the sham arm leaving the rotation at its floor; the sham arm at G-F0m-Qwen's measured 136 of 160 realised rounds."

Code's reading inside Q7 (a): 'the sham arm leaving the rotation at its floor' is computed at two launch counts: ceil(32 / r) = 43, at the unit's one rate r = 18/24 (m:192), and 32, the fewest at which the sham can reach its floor. A0 launches to its L in both. Both floor cases keep 10 rounds per sham launch; in the 43 case that over-counts the rounds of the about 11 sessions it assumes end early at an exclusion. The guard's figures move with the sham's launches. The 136-of-160 case changes rounds only, so only round_degeneracy is recomputed there, at 136/16 = 17/2 rounds per sham launch.

Q7 (b), verbatim: "the absolute half exact at p0 = .20 over the contrast arm's launches per look; the Fisher half under a common null rate equal to the absolute p0, with a grid of rates and the supremum beside; the guard's false-pause figure as the union — the probability that either half fires at some look — computed jointly over the contrast and sham counts under the common null rate, each half's own figure beside."

Code's reading inside Q7 (b): 'the supremum' is reported as the maximum over the grid j/100 (j = 1..99), refined to .001 within +/- .01 of that maximum; a grid maximum bounds the supremum over (0, 1) from below. The union is also reported at its grid maximum over common rates p <= .20, where neither half's pause is a true one. Every session of both arms is excluded before its first pick independently at the common rate, and both halves count sessions launched in the arm through the look (bars.py:509). The grid, its maximum and the union's maximum are figured on the projection only; the cases beside carry the figures at the common rate .20. An exact tie between rates goes to the smaller rate (no tie occurs on any grid computed here).

Q7 (c), verbatim: "the joint figure is `round_degeneracy`'s own, with the guard's beside; the non-separable joint over the bar and the guard is not computed, and G-PWR says why in one sentence." The hair triggers carry no p0, and the lexical bar has no domain in Q-F0 (m:330), so neither has a figure.

m:190's raise is not triggered: power at the floors is at least .85. Had it been below, this program would stop and escalate rather than apply the raise, whose 'sham in proportion' clause it does not settle.
